scope: Bounded NTFS directory-index observation through the existing image.inspect contract and common CLI/stdio/GUI/TUI/shell actions.
proposed_ownership: Extend existing runtime inspection request/port/projection and platform NTFS action binding. Place a shared private mode type inward if runtime and provider both require it; do not make runtime depend on provider headers or add a second scheduler/command registry.
contracts_to_define: Exact view/parameter grammar, full reference/default-root meaning and invalid combinations before any source access.
Bounded directory/closure/entry/region projection with original hashes and precise omitted-versus-acquisition facts; preserve lossless names and escaped display.
Complete/partial/refused/unresolved outcome semantics, occupied request slot, actual-exit and source-free snapshot binding across all existing frontends.
Independent before-code fixtures/expectations, byte limits, old-bootstrap regressions and exact native acceptance commands.
